why_this_file: THE BRIDGE STANDS ON THE LATEST DISCLOSED BALANCE SHEET [R-BRIDGE-01]. This replaces bs_1q2026.json as the bridge sheet: the reviewed 30-June-2026 statements supersede the 31-March-2026 ones, and a bridge left on the older sheet is the stale-sheet defect that rule was adopted on. The projected statements keep FY2025 as their audited base year — a working-capital cycle measured on full years is not restarted from a half. TWO LINES ARE NOT RECORDED BECAUSE THEY WERE NOT READ: advance payments for investments acquisition, and the deferred tax asset. Their sum is recoverable by difference as 127.301240 against the printed non-current subtotal, and a figure recovered by difference is not a figure read, so neither is committed and neither is used. SIGCM clause 8: a missing item is recorded as missing, never omitted.
